verdict.rationale: AutoGen provides multiple documented multi-agent orchestration patterns: RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat, Swarm (handoffs via HandoffMessage), GraphFlow (directed graph workflows), MagenticOneGroupChat, and AgentTool for nested agent orchestration, plus AutoGen Studio for visual team composition — covering handoffs, subagents, and crew-like teams within one workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks specifically validating handoff/GraphFlow correctness at scale beyond docs.
